  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "The {{ing_01|pig}} is boned and garnished with a little {{ing_02|wine sauce}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Parboil with {{ing_03|green laurel}} in the center and place it in the oven to be roasted sufficiently."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Meanwhile, put in the mortar {{ing_04|pepper}}, {{ing_05|lovage}}, {{ing_06|carraway}}, {{ing_07|celery seed}}, {{ing_08|laser root}}, and {{ing_09|laurel berries}}, crush them."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Moisten with {{ing_10|broth}}, {{ing_11|wine}} and {{ing_12|raisin wine}} to taste."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Put this in a sauce pan and heat."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Bind with {{ing_14|roux}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "Untie the {{ing_01|pig}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "text": "Remove the {{ing_03|laurel leaves}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 9,
      "text": "Incorporate the {{ing_15|juice of the bones}} (from which a gravy has been made in the meantime) and serve."
    }
  ],
